profile.headline: Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman
profile.summary: Alvin Nguyen currently works as a Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman. As a college graduate from UC Irvine, he has not only developed a passion for coding and cybersecurity, but he actively participates in the community and fosters leadership development in his peers. He is committed to helping others in as many ways as possible, whether it be serving the homeless and cleaning up the beach or tutoring students.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Manhattan Beach, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Streamlined the DevOps process by integrating tools such as Confluence and helping set up HP Fortify Scans
- Refactored Python scripts that pulled TeamForge commit data and SPR issue tracking data to display on a dashboard
- Developed Python script that utilize TeamForge, Fortify, and RESTful APIs to pull recent HP Fortify Scan results and displayed it onto a Mattermost channel

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Learned C# and XAML to work on a Mission Planning System codebase
- Debugged certain aspects on the program and added more functionality to some procedures
- Wrote unit tests to improve code coverage
- Created and implemented design for new test tool that served to verify data

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a team of 6 interns to enhance an internal staffing tool by integrating social media hooks and improving the graphical interface of the site
- Coordinated tasks and organized presentation as team leader
- Networked with many skilled professionals in systems engineering, safety engineering, computer programming, etc
- Learned critical skills such as Linux, Java, and Python and its applications in a corporate environment
- Created a proof of concept program to organize volunteers in an event of a disaster or humanitarian crisis
- Awarded 3rd Place in Northrop Grumman's Space Park Code-A-Thon 2017 for Interns

positions.title: Student Tutor
positions.description:
- Collaborated with four other tutors to ensure that students finish their homework in a timely manner
- Served at least 5 students per hour
- Assisted employer with other tasks necessary to run the center smoothly

positions.title: Student Poll Worker
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a team of 5 in order to efficiently process votes
- Processed over 500 electronic votes 
- Successfully helped 5 people per hour with voter information and the process of voting 
- Set up polling place quickly and productively within 30 minutes

honors.title: Honor Roll: Golden Aztec
honors.description: Awarded to students who have earned an academic weighted grade point average of 4.0 or above.
honors.issuer: Issued by La Quinta High School · Jul 2017

honors.title: National AP Scholar
honors.description: Granted to students in the United States who receive an average score of at least 4 on all AP Exams taken, and scores of 4 or higher on eight or more of these exams.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Accumulated over 100 service hours
- Successfully booked enjoyable service projects for members
- Organized meetings, event pages, and calendars for the organization
- Featured 7 times in the Jet Divisional Newsletter 
- Featured 2 times in the Cal-Nev-Ha District Newsletter
- Awarded Distinguished Vice President by the CNH KIWIN’S District (2017)
- Awarded Officer of the Year of Jet Division (2017)

- Promoted leadership development in members by attending leadership seminars
- Booked over 15 successful service projects for members
- Coordinated with team members to plan meetings, organize presentations, and host fundraisers
- Accumulated over 50 service hours

projects.title: Project Slimey - HackUCI
projects.description:
- Collaborated with three students to create a functional, server-side web application game 
- Learned the basics of  Node.js and Express.js and how it connects a server to HTML/CSS
- Programmed a class constructor in JavaScript
- Contributed to basic HTML/CSS structure of the web application

projects.title: Repair Ship Game - Global Game Jam 2018
projects.description:
- Coordinated alongside artists and writers to create an interactive game that promoted kindness qualities
- Utilized Unity to implement short mini-games into the storyline
- Learned how to program in C#
